actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a NEW complete 4-panel Japanese anime prop design sheet on clean white landscape canvas, preferably1536x1024, showing ONLY Bunny's simplified BLACK TROUSER WAIST BELT. Fresh hand-drawn clean lineart + flat cel color, no collage or photo realism. Image1 and Image2 are the accepted front/back FULL FIGURES and provide belt buckle appearance, black belt width/style, and red trouser loop placement. Show the exact same simple belt. These are clothing design concepts, not engineering or production diagrams.
Panel1 label BELT: one whole black waist-belt ring in a readable 3/4 view, with the simple BLACK low-profile rectangular frame/prong buckle at the FRONT only and two tiny plain-black flat empty mounting slots at rear-outside positions. The rear center is uninterrupted strap, no rear buckle. The belt has no shoulder, chest or harness branches. No orange medallions, no silver hooks/carabiners/chains.
Panel2 label BUCKLE: enlarged clear view of the same single dark rectangular buckle/frame and short belt end with sparse adjustment holes. The buckle attaches to ONE continuous black strap, no extra locking systems or hanging tabs.
Panel3 label LOOPS: clean cropped RED SHORTS WAISTBAND only, showing the black belt threaded BEHIND existing vertical RED FABRIC TROUSER LOOPS, one plain red central rear loop. Pants fabric/loops actually cover the belt, not floating. No human torso, no upper garment.
Panel4 label DIRECT MOUNT: enlarged side/3/4 detail of ONE small EMPTY black sheath-mounting clip fixed DIRECTLY to the belt itself, with short flat slot/base hugging belt and a simple downward-facing receiver. It is empty, no sheath or weapon. No long vertical straps, chain, carabiner, or connection above waistband. Use one assembled view plus one clearly separate side section if needed; do not show duplicated detached pieces as if still on same assembly. Keep details concept-level, no dimensions, load claims or elaborate mechanisms.
Use restrained charcoal, black, subtle dark gray edge planes and red only for the shorts demonstration. Matte surfaces, clean hard highlights, no gray patina, white blotches/noise, soft painterly wash or oily3D. Clear balanced panel spacing; labels exactly BELT, BUCKLE, LOOPS, DIRECT MOUNT, no extra prose.

native_output.record_note: Actual output metadata and returned native file; no reconstructed data URL.

reference_basis: Actual belt-layer front and back references establish the one black waist belt and empty direct mount; no cancelled torso harness is a current design requirement.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only
limitations: Appearance and mounting-position concept; buckle internals, loads and manufacturing tolerances are not verified.
